ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_INTRO: My name is Diego. As a developer specializing in Front-End, I'm dedicated to creating digital experiences that don't just look great, but are also intuitive and perform flawlessly.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_SOCIAL_IMPACT: Beyond technology, I am driven by projects that create a positive social impact. My greatest motivation is knowing that my code is contributing to a good cause and bringing real value to society.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_STRATEGY: My passion for rock climbing has taught me to approach each project with patience and strategy, breaking down big challenges into manageable steps to reach the final goal. Music teaches me to focus on rhythm and detail, two keys I consider essential for creating a great user experience.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_CLIENT_PARTNER: For me, every client is a partner. I believe in transparent communication, impeccable organization and in building a trusting relationship.

EXPERIENCE.DESCRIPTION_BOSCH: Sales agent for the mobile phone company Orange, through its subcontractor Bosch.

SUCCESS_CASES.ALT_PORTAL_CONVOCATORIAS: Call for Proposals Portal Grant Library
SUCCESS_CASES.PROBLEM_BABE: Managing and planning road routes for large vehicles, seeking the fastest and most fuel-efficient way.
SUCCESS_CASES.PROBLEM_DATALAIA: Handling large volumes of data without a visual or interactive way to explore and visualize them.
SUCCESS_CASES.PROBLEM_DISCAMINO: Managing training routes, associating people with mobility issues with their specific adapted vehicles and an available, prepared pilot. The volume of routes they carried out was no longer manageable through a notebook.
SUCCESS_CASES.PROBLEM_HERMES: ArcelorMittal needed a way to supervise and plan the rail, road, and maritime transport of materials the company conducts nationwide. Previously, there were several different applications that lacked any communication between them and were completely obsolete.
SUCCESS_CASES.PROBLEM_LALIGA: LALIGA lacked a centralized tool to manage the commercial data of subscribed bars or to know the actual status of the contracted football packages.
SUCCESS_CASES.PROBLEM_PORTAL_CONVOCATORIAS: Public grants and calls in Spain are scattered across dozens of official bulletins and portals; finding the relevant ones requires hours of manual search and review.
SUCCESS_CASES.SOLUTION_BABE: Road route management system integrated with the HERE API. It allows calculating optimized routes considering parameters such as vehicle weight and dimensions.
SUCCESS_CASES.SOLUTION_DATALAIA: Data analysis platform that allows visualizing large volumes of information through interactive charts and customizable dashboards.
SUCCESS_CASES.SOLUTION_DISCAMINO: Platform that manages calendars, routes, and the assignment of drivers and vehicles for the stages and training sessions of the Camino de Santiago.
SUCCESS_CASES.SOLUTION_HERMES: Internal applications for rail, road, and maritime logistics management with advanced fleet control features and communication between them and the external web via RabbitMQ queues.
SUCCESS_CASES.SOLUTION_LALIGA: CRM and web portal for commercial data management and analysis of the current status of the contracted football package for subscribed businesses. It includes dynamic visualization of key metrics and customer segmentation.
SUCCESS_CASES.SOLUTION_PORTAL_CONVOCATORIAS: Web application that functions as an automatically generated library of Spanish grants and calls.
